description: Na₂ThF₆ crystallizes in the trigonal P321 space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F¹⁻ atoms. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and three longer (2.41 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Th⁴⁺ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F¹⁻ atoms. There are three shorter (2.27 Å) and six longer (2.44 Å) Th-F bond lengths. There are two inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and two equivalent Th⁴⁺ atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂Th₂ tetrahedra. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Th⁴⁺ atom.
